--- gl_vector_helpers ---
/* C89 replacements for C99 compound GL literals. */

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat3(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat3_buf[3];
  repl_glfloat3_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat3_buf[2] = c;
  return repl_glfloat3_buf;
}

static GLfloat *repl_glfloat4(GLfloat a, GLfloat b, GLfloat c, GLfloat d) {
  static GLfloat repl_glfloat4_buf[4];
  repl_glfloat4_buf[0] = a;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[1] = b;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[2] = c;
  repl_glfloat4_buf[3] = d;
  return repl_glfloat4_buf;
}

--- source ---
  // Sierpinski carpet: cut the middle cell out of a 3x3 grid, then do the
  // same to the 8 cells that remain. Each call owns one square; u is a
  // 0..1 shade the children nudge so the tiles ramp MAGENTA -> AZURE.
  carpet(depth, size, u) {
    // Base case: fill this cell. The holes are simply cells nobody fills.
    if(depth <= 0) {
      glColor3f(0.95 - 0.8*u, 0.25 + 0.3*u, 1);
      glBegin(GL_QUADS);
        glNormal3f(0, 0, 1);
        glVertex3f(-0.5*size, -0.5*size, 0);
        glVertex3f(0.5*size, -0.5*size, 0);
        glVertex3f(0.5*size, 0.5*size, 0);
        glVertex3f(-0.5*size, 0.5*size, 0);
      glEnd();
    }
    // Recursive case: walk the 3x3 grid -- loops are half-open, so
    // -1..2 visits -1, 0, 1 -- and skip the center cell.
    if(depth > 0) {
      for(i, -1, 2) {
        for(j, -1, 2) {
          if(abs(i) + abs(j) > 0) {
            glPushMatrix();
              glTranslatef(i*size/3, j*size/3, 0);
              carpet(depth - 1, size/3, u + (i + j)*0.12);
            glPopMatrix();
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glRotatef(sin(t*0.35)*10, 0, 0, 1);
  carpet(2, 3.6, 0.5);
